sections.from: Scenic stretch in Daganzo de Arriba
sections.advice: This Scenic stretch in Daganzo de Arriba → High point in Campo Real stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Ciempozuelos → Near Getafe is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.
